t: This is New Cross Fire Station, a Grade II listed building at 266 Queens Road. It was designed by Robert Pearsall, who was architect to the London Fire Brigade. He designed several notable fire stations for them, and seven of those are now Grade II listed. His work included Woolwich Fire Station, built in 1887, and extensions to Clerkenwell's station, which was London's oldest operational fire station until it closed in January 2014, along with nine others.
